dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible across the dorsal-lateral surface. The most prominent 3-5 structures feature high-intensity white perimeters with irregular, jagged geometries (approx. 2-8 pixels in width) that create a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior coat to the high-intensity perimeter line, surrounding a dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. Concentration is highest in the anterior dorsal region near the neck and distributed in a linear-scatter pattern along the lower posterior flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle, with the longest edge oriented parallel to the spinal curvature and the most anterior point situated superiorly to the others.
